async function save(x) {
	return x;
}

// CASE awaited_iife expect=fire
async function h1(items) {
	for (const item of items) {
		await (async () => {
			await save(item);
		})();
	}
}

// CASE awaited_local_function expect=fire
async function h2(items) {
	for (const item of items) {
		async function step() {
			await save(item);
		}
		await step();
	}
}

// CASE then_chain_awaited expect=fire
async function h3(items) {
	for (const item of items) {
		await save(item).then((r) => r);
	}
}

// CASE entries_destructure expect=fire
async function h4(map) {
	for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(map)) {
		await save(key + value);
	}
}

// CASE join_per_pass expect=fire
async function h5(groups) {
	for (const group of groups) {
		await Promise.all(group.map((x) => save(x)));
	}
}

// CASE await_inside_array_arg expect=fire
async function h6(items) {
	for (const item of items) {
		use([await save(item)]);
	}
}

// CASE ternary_await expect=fire
async function h7(items) {
	for (const item of items) {
		const v = item ? await save(item) : null;
		use(v);
	}
}

// CASE logical_await expect=fire
async function h8(items) {
	for (const item of items) {
		item && (await save(item));
	}
}

// CASE for_each_async_not_awaited expect=pass
function h9(items) {
	items.forEach(async (item) => {
		await save(item);
	});
}

// CASE while_index expect=fire
async function h10(items) {
	let i = 0;
	while (i < items.length) {
		await save(items[i++]);
	}
}

// CASE do_while expect=fire
async function h11(items) {
	let i = 0;
	do {
		await save(items[i]);
	} while (++i < items.length);
}

// CASE try_finally_await expect=fire
async function h12(items) {
	for (const item of items) {
		try {
			use(item);
		} finally {
			await save(item);
		}
	}
}

// CASE await_in_template expect=fire
async function h13(items) {
	for (const item of items) {
		use(`${await save(item)}`);
	}
}

// CASE class_method_loop expect=fire
class Repo {
	async saveAll(items) {
		for (const item of items) {
			await this.save(item);
		}
	}
	async save(x) {}
}
function use() {}
